paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.19% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+5.25%) and FTSE 100 weakest (-2.16%). Brent crude changed -6.02% to 100.18. Gold changed -2.35% to 4,196.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.70% to 83,818.3438. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.293%, a relative move of +3.50%. Among the firms tracked, Apollo (-6.67%) and Newmont (-6.65%) moved the most.
